note: Generated by extract-brushes.mjs from the ShowHelp function and the probability tables of No Paint's Index event sheet (2021 project, resaved by Construct r495.2). options, desc, ranges and by are the game's own help text with its colour tags removed. table and weight say which weighted table proposes the brush on its own (null: only by name at the prompt). The game's main loop takes its first proposal from Brushes; after that Brushes two times in three and Filters one time in three (an OR block: firstIndex, or choose(0, 1, 2) is not 0), then a brush by weight, and never the same filter twice running. A ? at the prompt or in a playlist picks one of the two tables at even odds.
